categories.main_business_segments: The Company operates primarily in the aluminum industry, with main segments including alumina production (mining and refining bauxite into alumina), primary aluminum production (smelting alumina into primary aluminum and producing carbon and aluminum alloy products), trading (marketing and logistics of alumina, aluminum, non-ferrous metals, coal, and raw materials), and energy (coal mining, thermal power, wind and photovoltaic power generation, and new energy equipment manufacturing). Corporate and other segments include headquarters management and R&D activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Company utilizes advanced smelting and refining technologies for alumina and primary aluminum production, including electrolytic aluminum smelting. It emphasizes technological innovation with a strong R&D focus, including green aluminum production, energy-saving and carbon reduction technologies, bauxite resource utilization, and digital transformation such as intelligent factory construction and automation technologies. The Company also applies scientific management and digital intelligence to optimize production efficiency and environmental performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic electrolytic aluminum enterprises for alumina products, and domestic aluminum fabrication enterprises and distributors for primary aluminum products. The Company sells through long-term agreements and spot markets, serving both internal Group companies and external customers. The trading segment serves both internal manufacturing plants and external customers domestically and internationally. The energy segment sells coal and electricity primarily to internal and external energy consumers and local grid companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in Mainland China, with significant production facilities and subsidiaries across provinces such as Guangxi, Qinghai, Guizhou, Shanxi, Shandong, Inner Mongolia, Yunnan, and Ningxia. It also has overseas operations including bauxite mining and trading through its Hong Kong subsidiary and international trading activities. The Company’s products are sold domestically and internationally, with export activities and overseas resource acquisition.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Company operates an integrated industrial chain covering upstream resource exploration and mining (bauxite, coal), midstream production of alumina and primary aluminum, downstream aluminum alloy and carbon products manufacturing, as well as trading, logistics, and energy supply. It controls the supply chain from raw material acquisition through to product sales and international trade, positioning itself as a fully integrated aluminum industry enterprise.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include building a world-class aluminum company with global competitiveness, focusing on technological innovation, green and low-carbon development, digital transformation, and extreme management. R&D initiatives target green aluminum production, energy-saving and carbon reduction technologies, bauxite resource utilization, and intelligent manufacturing. The Company emphasizes integration of industry, academia, and research, with multiple innovation platforms and a strong scientific talent team to drive breakthroughs and industrial application of new technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of alumina, primary aluminum, aluminum alloy, carbon products, coal, and electricity. The Company also earns revenue from trading activities involving non-ferrous metals and raw materials, logistics and transportation services, and technical development services. Sales are conducted via long-term contracts, spot market sales, futures contracts, and service agreements, with internal and external customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Company is a leading enterprise in the Chinese aluminum industry and ranks among the top globally in terms of production capacity and comprehensive strength. It holds the world’s largest production capacity for alumina, electrolytic aluminum, fine alumina, high-purity aluminum, aluminum anodes, and gallium metal. Its integrated industrial chain and resource base provide a distinct competitive edge. Major competitors include other large aluminum producers domestically and internationally, but the Company maintains a leading position through scale, technology, and resource control.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group reported revenue of RMB237.066 billion, a 5.21% increase year-on-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB12.4 billion, an 85.38% increase. Total assets were RMB215.9 billion with a gearing ratio of 48.10%, the lowest in nearly a decade. The Company achieved record-high production and profitability, with strong cash flow generation and improved return on equity. Capital expenditures totaled RMB13.467 billion focused on capacity expansion, technological upgrades, and environmental projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Company emphasizes stable and reliable supply of bauxite resources, a complete industrial chain, advanced management, and continuous technological innovation to ensure high productivity and product quality. It differentiates itself through its scale, integration from resource acquisition to product sales, green and low-carbon production capabilities, and digital transformation initiatives. The Company also focuses on customer service, customized solutions, and maintaining strong relationships with key customers to enhance value creation and competitiveness.
